scams.name: Koh Samui Airport Taxi Mafia & Grab Blocking
scams.description: You land at Koh Samui Airport (USM) and open Grab. A driver 25 km away accepts a 400-baht fare to Bophut — then messages: ‘Cannot pick up airport, sorry, taxi mafia.’ You end up at the official taxi counter where the same trip is 800–1,200 baht. r/kohsamui ‘Taxi Mafia Shock’ documents it: ‘We’d taken a 35-minute Grab to Bangkok airport for 350 baht. In Samui they want 400 baht just to go to our hotel in Bophut.’ The Samui cartel is one of Thailand’s most aggressive — r/Thailand ‘A group of songthaew drivers blocked Nathon Pier on Koh Samui’ describes a 2023 incident where drivers physically blocked the ferry pier demanding a total ban on Grab and inDrive.
scams.avoidance: At Samui Airport, walk 500 meters outside the perimeter toward the main ring road before requesting Grab or Bolt — this exits the cartel zone. Benchmark Grab fares: USM airport to Chaweng 250 baht, to Bophut 300, to Lamai 400, to Nathon 500. Use inDrive as a backup when Grab drivers refuse — slightly fewer drivers, same fare logic. From Nathon Pier on ferry arrival, walk five minutes inland before calling a ride-share; pier-parked *songthaews* quote cartel rates. If overcharged at the airport taxi counter, photograph the receipt and report to Tourist Police on 1155 — enforcement has improved slightly in 2025.
scams.location: Samui Airport (USM), Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Nathon Pier

scams.name: Car & Scooter Rental ‘Damage’ Fee Shakedown
scams.description: You rent a car from ‘All Way Rent a Car’ on Samui for a week. You don’t smoke. On return the shop charges you a 3,000-baht smoking fee and refuses to release your passport deposit. r/kohsamui ‘SCAM ALERT: All Way Rent a Car in Koh Samui Charged Us 3,000 Baht for Smoking — We Never Smoked!’ (2025) is the named-shop warning; r/ThailandTourism ‘BEWARE Hakunarent RentCarSamui Car rental’ documents a parallel case at a second shop. The mechanic is simple: the shop manufactures a violation on return (smoking, minor scratch, cigarette smell) and holds your passport hostage until you pay a ‘fine’ that doesn’t exist in the rental contract.
scams.avoidance: Rent cars from airport counters of major brands (Budget, Avis, Thrifty) rather than Chaweng or Lamai storefronts. For scooters, offer a cash deposit of 3,000–5,000 baht plus a photocopy only — Cat Motors Samui and Mr Ting Big Bike accept this. Photograph every panel of the vehicle (including underside and interior) with timestamps, and upload to email or cloud. Cross-reference any rental shop name on r/kohsamui before paying; ‘All Way Rent a Car’ and ‘Hakunarent’ are both named scam shops. If your passport is held and a fake fee demanded, call Tourist Police on 1155 — the threat alone usually resolves it.
scams.location: Chaweng rental shops, Lamai main road, Bophut, Samui Airport rental counters

scams.name: NCK Travel & ‘Funny Day Tours’ Fake Tour Booking
scams.description: You book a zipline day tour for 1,500 baht at a Chaweng storefront called NCK Travel. The shop promises hotel pickup at 9am. Morning comes — no pickup. You walk back to the shop: closed, different sign, phone disconnected. r/kohsamui ‘Scam!!! NCK travel and tours’ names this operator by name: ‘Do not book with this uncle. Booked a zipline trip, promised to pick us up at the hotel, then tried to reschedule on his own time and refused to refund.’ A parallel thread, r/kohsamui ‘Warning….Went on a trip with Funny Day Tours,’ documents a named snorkel operator that delivered a 20-minute stop at a fish-free reef instead of the advertised full-day excursion.
scams.avoidance: Book tours — Ang Thong, zipline, snorkel, Phangan ferries — on 12go.asia, Klook, or GetYourGuide. If booking locally, ask for the actual operator’s name (not the booth’s) and verify on their official website. For Ang Thong Marine Park, use Seatran Discovery or 100 Degrees East; both are known legitimate operators. Pay by credit card; chargebacks resolve fly-by-night operator disputes in two to four weeks. Cross-reference booth names on r/kohsamui before paying — ‘NCK Travel’ and ‘Funny Day Tours’ are both flagged.
scams.location: Chaweng tour booking booths, Lamai beach booths, hotel lobby tour desks

scams.name: Chaweng Bar ‘Lady Drink’ & Ladyboy Charity Tout
scams.description: You sit down at a bar on Chaweng’s Soi Green Mango. A hostess sits next to you inside ninety seconds. She orders a 180-baht lady drink and the bill escalates from there. r/ThailandTourism ‘NEED ADVICE ON MY BUDGET IN THAILAND’ documents the pattern: ‘Lady drinks, bar fine, and whatever you negotiate with her can easily push the night past 3,000 baht. More for more ladies.’ r/ThailandTourism ‘What’s best go go bars in koh samui’ warns specifically: ‘There are only two go-gos on the island, both on Soi Green Mango — and one is insanely overpriced.’
scams.avoidance: Pay for each drink at the bar individually. Never run a tab; never let a hostess order for the table. Set a 2,000-baht cash limit before going out and leave cards at the hotel. Decline all ‘charity’ donation books — legitimate Thai charities do not solicit bar customers. Choose posted-price venues: Ark Bar Chaweng, the Green Mango main venue, Beach Republic Lamai. If a padded bill arrives, call Tourist Police on 1155; the bar folds quickly at the mention of police.
scams.location: Chaweng Beach Road, Soi Green Mango, Lamai Walking Street, Ark Bar area

scams.name: Chaweng Parking ‘Attendant’ Fee & Fake Currency Exchange
scams.description: You park your rental scooter near Chaweng beach and a man in a faded hi-vis vest approaches demanding a 50–100 baht ‘parking fee.’ There is no official paid parking on Chaweng’s main beach — the ‘attendants’ are freelance opportunists. r/kohsamui ‘Chaweng Parking Scam’ is the community flag. The per-incident hit is small (50–200 baht) but the volume is relentless. The parallel pharmacy and mini-mart short-change scam runs the same way as Patong’s: the cashier substitutes a smaller note during change and returns 100 baht less than correct.
scams.avoidance: Ignore street ‘parking attendants’ on Chaweng; no such official service exists. Exchange money only at SuperRich or bank counters with posted rates and official receipts. Count change in front of the vendor; if short, stay in place and point at shelf prices. For massages, use hotel spas or venues with posted prices — not beach touts. At restaurants, ask to see the Thai-language menu; prices should match the English one.
scams.location: Chaweng Beach Road, Central Festival Samui parking, Lamai night market
